Episode 2294 of the Joe Rogan Experience brings Dr. Suzanne Humphries to Rogan's studio for a full-length conversation. Humphries is a medical doctor who became known for her sharp criticism of vaccine policy. Her visit gives her the show's usual long, open format to make her case.

Humphries sets out her doubts about vaccine safety and the way health agencies present risk to the public. Rogan asks how her views formed and why they clash with the medical mainstream. Listeners hear a contested position argued at length, in the guest's own words, rather than in short clips or summaries.
